summary: A Period 8 house sitting Zi (N2) and facing Wu (S2), with Double Stars at Facing: the timely 8 White arrives at the south facing palace as both the Mountain Star and the Facing Star. This chart wants open space close by on the south side and higher ground further away; then both people and wealth do well. Your home has a tall building close by to the south, so the Facing Star meets a 'mountain' instead of open space and wealth finds it hard to come in. The Mountain Star 8 White, on the other hand, gains support from that building, which favours the household's health.

palaces.离: Facing palace. Mountain 8 and Facing 8 meet here. It wants openness nearby and height in the distance; the nearby building presses on the wealth star. In 2026 the annual 5 Yellow arrives here, so keep the entrance area quiet and avoid building work.
palaces.坎: Sitting palace. Mountain 9, Facing 7: 9 Purple is the timely star of Period 9. A solid wall or tall building behind the house gives support and favours the household.
palaces.艮: The Facing Star 9 Purple, the wealth star of Period 9, sits here. Use any doors, windows or open space in this area more.
palaces.乾: Mountain 5, Facing 2, and in 2026 the annual 2 Black arrives too: 2 Black and 5 Yellow together. Keep this room quiet and tidy; elderly family members should not stay here for long.

advice: Put the main living area and the desk in the northeast, where the Facing Star 9 Purple sits
Keep the inside of the south entrance clear and bright, with no clutter
Use the northwest room less and keep it tidy; no building work at the south entrance this year
